Base coefficient/FFT/remainder arrays now use eight bytes per element instead of twenty-four; extension arrays remain twenty-four bytes. The getter ABI still returns E and base conversion checks the two other coordinates, so conversion work is not free. DFT workspace, output copies, alignment, allocator/runtime and complete jointly live storage are not admitted by this type change. Private pads remain at their original message-row exponent, never at the end of the live prefix. No support assumption is transferred to folded oracles. Public zero source calls are now eliminated; the unchanged source-read discipline of the preceding rational Pow step applies to the residual consumer, not to these newly split initial RS openings. Existing denominator coefficient levels, inverse spectrum, block numerators/intermediates, amplitude and advance vectors, DFT scratch/caches, low/high output blocks and factored Eq tables coexist with the residual state. These local allocations are not all covered by State::named_bytes. No full source-sized weight vector is created above the existing <=6-variable terminal fallback. Setup is rebuilt between calls/adaptive rounds, not retained across both challenges as in the canonical plan. The <=16-variable residual guard and B<=256 reference cap remain. The old finite canonical precompute ledger is not replaced by these CPU tests; full source-uniform work, live accelerator storage, native canonical integration, real Gamma and H100 preflight remain open. No GPU/time/arena margin credit or new Lean claim.
